messages:
maya: Quick sync — I pushed a PRD draft for embedding/rerank edge cases. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd-embed-edgecases (draft)

alex: Saw it, skimming now. Main ask from infra/product: how do we handle dim changes w/ backwards compatibility?

sam: Big Q: do we support 2-step migration (dual write + reindex) or force full reindex? Customer impact could be high.

jordan: CS flagged one enterprise customer who cannot reindex full corpus. Could we provide a runtime compatibility layer to avoid full reindex?

maya: In the doc I sketched 3 modes — strict (reject mismatch), transform (normalize dims via PCA/zero-pad), and translation (on-the-fly learned linear map). Need feasibility estimates from eng.

liam: Platform note: runtime transform is expensive at scale. Batching helps but increases tail latency; need numbers.

alex: Agree. Propose acceptance criteria: 1) no-ops for same-dim; 2) transform latency < 2ms/vector for small dims, < 10ms/vector for larger ones; 3) memory overhead < 8% per serving node. (numbers are placeholders)

pat: From CS: acceptance criteria also must include 'customer opt-in migration window' and 'rollback to old embeddings without downtime'.

sam: Edgecases we must cover: normalization mismatch (L2 vs no-normalize), cross-batch mixing of old/new embeddings, and dtype/quantization differences (fp32 vs int8).

maya: Added a pseudo-code snippet to the doc to show behaviour.

alex: paste snippet?

maya: ```
# on ingest
if incoming.dim != index.dim:
  if mode == 'strict': reject
  elif mode == 'zero-pad': pad_with_zeros()
  elif mode == 'pca-project': project_to_index_space()

# on query
if query.embedding.dim != index.dim:
  use_runtime_transform(query.embedding)
```

liam: We should run perf microbenchmarks: pad vs pca vs learned linear map. I'll schedule a perf run and post numbers.

sam: Also need tests for batch semantics: mixing dims in a batch should either be rejected or all transformed to same dim before ANN search. Document the deterministic ordering for transforms.

alex: Acceptance criteria update: include test harness + sample datasets + quantization regression checks.

maya: Proposed launch criteria in doc: (a) PRD signoff, (b) perf bench meeting SLOs (p99 latency), (c) e2e customer migration tested, (d) rollback plan + migration playbook.

jordan: Timeline ask: can we ship a limited beta to one customer in ~6 weeks? Realistic?

liam: 6 weeks is plausible if we scope to zero-pad + synchronous transform disabled in hot path. PCA/learned-map require more research cycles.

pat: Customer is willing to be beta if we can guarantee data isolation and a clear migration window.

maya: OK I'll update the PRD with the modes, acceptance criteria, and add TODOs for batching semantics tests and a migration playbook. Tagging @alex @sam to review PRD by EOD Friday.

deploy-bot: maya created doc 'PRD: Embedding compatibility & rerank edgecases' (https://redwood.internal/docs/prd-embed-edgecases)

alex: Will review. Quick note: add a clear metric for quality delta — suggest NDCG drop <= 2% over baseline; otherwise block rollout.

sam: Add that under 'quality guardrails' and include sample evaluation prompts.

maya: Noted. Thanks everyone. We'll sync Thu 10am for tradeoffs.

jordan: :thumbsup:
